description_expanded:
30A Stars and Stripes by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 30A Stars and Stripes is the kind of beach house that makes you exhale the second you walk in. High ceilings, exposed beams, and a glowing chandelier set the tone in a living space that feels instantly relaxed and polished. Enjoy the cozy fireplace and big windows that pull in bright tropical views. Finished gawking at the stunning interiors? Then hop on one of the 4 bikes and cruise to one of two community pools.

Nice! Highlights: 📍 Cassine Village in Seagrove Beach 🏖️.4 miles from One Seagrove Beach Access 👙 2 community pools! 🎾 Tennis Courts 🚲 4 bikes! 🛌 4 bedrooms, 3 baths 🔥 Gas grill Inside, the kitchen is built for real beach living: rich blue cabinetry, gleaming quartz, and a generous island that naturally becomes the gathering spot. The dining table is made for easy, linger-worthy meals. Bedrooms feel like personal hideaways. The primary suite leans into dramatic navy walls and a four-poster bed, plus a sleek bath with a walk-in shower and dual marble vanities. Guest rooms are light and comfortable, while the custom-built bunk room adds a playful, cozy touch kids will claim immediately. Outside, mornings start on the screened porch with a slow coffee, afternoons land by the palm-lined pool, and beach days unfold via a wooden boardwalk to white sand and turquoise water. Set in a quiet, tree-lined community minutes from the beach, with pools, tennis courts, and covered parking, this home makes group trips feel effortless and a whole lotta fun! At Oversee 30A, we keep it simple: clean, comfy stays with a local team always close by. Our office is nearby, open seven days a week, with 24/7 support if you need anything. Overview: - .4 miles from One Seagrove Beach Access - 4 bedrooms, 3 baths - 2 community pools - 4 bikes included - Access to community tennis courts - In-unit washer and dryer - Gas grill - Screened-in porch - Wi-Fi - Covered parking Overnight: FIRST FLOOR - Guest Room: Queen bed, shared bath, TV SECOND FLOOR - Primary Bedroom: King bed, private bathroom, shower only, TV - Guest Room: King bed, private bathroom, shower/tub combo, TV - Bunkroom: twin/twin bunks Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
